title: WebSocket reads do not validate lengths in the correct integer domain or require complete frames
summary: WebSocket uint64 length is compared after signed-long conversion but masking uses original length; Windows 32-bit long can admit oversized masked frames. Positive short reads are also accepted. Next: validate before conversion, exact reads and frame semantics; Windows/LP64 regressions. Confirmed by current source contracts; no fix or runtime retest claimed.
